articles.title: 5 Near-Perfect Action Shows That Are Streaming Online for Free
articles.summary: Unfortunately, all of the aforementioned shows require a paid subscription if you wish to enjoy them. If you’re on the lookout for action titles that can be streamed for free on Pluto TV, Tubi, or Roku, look no further.
body: A good action show can turn anyone’s day around. Kinetic choreography in a series like Reacher or Daredevil informs the motivations of its characters while injecting excitement between quieter moments. Some stories even push the limits of what action looks like on television, like Prime Video’s The Boys, which approaches the superhero genre through a viscerally satirical lens.

Sam Raimi’s Evil Dead trilogy puts Ash Williams (Bruce Campbell) through the wringer. Just when you think his trials are over, Ash vs Evil Dead forces an older Ash to combat Deadites 30 years after the ending of Army of Darkness. This time, however, Ash isn’t alone, as sidekicks Pablo (Ray Santiago) and Kelly (Dana DeLorenzo) join his cause. Although Ash is initially reluctant to let go of the peace that came with decades of mundanity, he must take accountability after accidentally unleashing a Deadite plague after reading passages from the Book of the Dead to impress a woman.

articles.title: Prime Video's Reacher Is Officially Returning Next Month After a Stellar Season 4
articles.summary: If there’s one thing Reacher fans can count on, it’s that Jack Reacher is never gone for very long. The Prime Video series has turned Lee Child’s wandering ex-military cop into one of TV ’s most reliably entertaining action heroes.
body: Not quite. Jack Reacher is already slated for a return this October, just not on television. Lee and Andrew Child are releasing a new novel in the exciting series called Chain Reaction, the 31st Jack Reacher outing, giving fans another dose of the beloved character before the show returns for its fifth season.

If Alan Ritchson ’s portrayal of the character has become one of your biggest TV obsessions, there’s never been a better moment to dive into the books. While the show does a fantastic job of introducing Lee Child’s iconic character — even better than the Tom Cruise movies — more than three decades of stories are waiting on the page. Child’s prose delivers a brand of pulse-pounding satisfaction for mystery buffs that the screen can only begin to match, and his latest offering is slated to be another exciting thrill ride.

articles.title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother Review
articles.summary: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother review: Mahershala Ali joins his would-be Blade director as a devout sword-wielding assassin.
body: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother arrives in theaters on September 25. This review is based on a screening from the 2026 Toronto International Film Festival.

Once upon a time, Oscar-winning actor Mahershala Ali was meant to play slick vampire hunter Blade for Marvel Studios under Mogul Mowgli and Bait director Bassam Tariq. The project never materialized, but it led the Muslim actor-filmmaker pair to team up for Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother, a surprisingly thoughtful, action-tinged crime drama about a devout hit man trying to find breast milk for his infant daughter. This takes him through mosques and strip clubs alike in rural Virginia, laying out a visually and emotionally multifaceted journey across a heightened American landscape.

articles.title: GTA 6 Is About to Totally Reinvent One of the Best Experiences in Video Games
articles.summary: It’s quite literally the name of the game: Rockstar’s Grand Theft Auto series is all about stealing cars. And the latest installment of the franchise, GTA 6, seems like it’s about to revolutionize one of the most thrilling experiences players can have in a video game.
body: Back in GTA 5, stealing cars was a more streamlined affair: you’d approach a vehicle with someone in it, and force them out with a single button press. You could also aim your weapon at them to force them to abandon the car, or bust open the window of a parked car with a well-placed elbow, but it was still a pretty simple process. That’s no longer the case in GTA 6.

According to IGN, the latest game in the series will introduce a tiered security system for stealing cars. Just like in real life, pricier vehicles with enhanced technology will require specific skills and tools to steal. That means players will have to think more deeply about which cars to boost, and when. This time around, Jason and Lucia will have access to a device called a “wank scanner,” which will display information about a car’s security system and value.

What’s more, unlike in previous GTA games, in GTA 6, you’ll be able to sell any car you’ve stolen. This game will have a fence system for stolen goods that’s more similar to that of 2018’s Red Dead Redemption 2. Who doesn’t appreciate a lucrative side-hustle?

articles.title: StarCraft Devs Promise New Game Will Definitely Release in 2030
articles.summary: We got the chance to speak with the developers of the new StaCcraft game, who explained why they shared such a distant release date and even teased some potential gameplay elements.
body: StarCraft is finally getting a new game, and it’s taking a drastically different approach from its predecessors; instead of an RTS, Blizzard’s grisly sci-fi property is making its debut in the realm of open-world shooters, and it’s set to launch in 2030.

That’s a long way out from now, and it’s anyone’s guess as to what the world will look like in four years. We got the chance to ask the developers everyone’s burning question at Blizzcon 2026: Why announce the game if there’s still so much time left before it releases?
Dan Hay, GM & VP of StarCraft and AnaLee Haertling, Associate Director, told us that sharing a firm release date helps keep them “honest” — and yes, 2030 is a firm release date.
When asked if 2030 was a solid date, Hay confirmed that it is, indeed, “solid.”

articles.title: 35 Years Later, the Greatest Detective Thriller Series of All Time Is Officially Free on Streaming
articles.summary: Fall makes for a great setting. There’s something special about the thick foliage and heavy clouds as the backdrop for a mercurial town, especially when a story is set within the framework of genre.
body: No show did this with more originality than Twin Peaks. Developed by David Lynch and Mark Frost, Twin Peaks is about a murder investigation, at least on paper. While it only ran for two seasons on ABC in the ‘90s, the series proved to be so much more than its premise suggested thanks largely to Lynch’s mood-first style of storytelling. In 2017, he returned to the world he helped establish with Twin Peaks: The Return – completing his vision and cementing the series as a must-watch for cinephiles, regardless of genre preferences.

Twin Peaks begins with the murder of Laura Palmer (Sheryl Lee), the town’s sweetheart and homecoming queen, whose body is unexpectedly washed ashore, naked and wrapped in plastic. As the town’s residents mourn her loss, FBI Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) arrives to investigate. But he very quickly begins peeling back seemingly endless layers to a vast mystery involving awful parents, weird psychologists, and an evil supernatural force. With each episode, the town’s secrets deepen, and the show expands in scope, exploring all manner of characters and stories, from cheating teens to money laundering and trafficking schemes.

articles.title: Diablo 5 Forging the Next Era Panel: Everything Announced
articles.summary: Blizzard has revealed three classes for Diablo 5, a first look at its UI, and shown off even more as part of its Forging the Next Era panel at BlizzCon 2026.
body: The next Diablo game might be years away from its spring 2029 launch, but that didn't stop some members of the development team from confirming the first details. Highlights from the 45-minute panel include confirmation that the Demon Hunter and Monk are two returning classes, but a new class is coming too: the Plague Knight.

Concept art, gameplay details, and more were all revealed as part of the big panel presentation. Blizzard also talked about why it decided to make the announcement now, almost three years before launch. We gathered all of the highlights for newcomers and die-hard fans to comb through right here. You can see everything announced at the Diablo 5 BlizzCon panel below.

Multiple members from the Diablo team have taken the stage at BlizzCon 2026. After the surprise reveal for Diablo 5, it's clear the developers have a lot to talk about. Shely said the plan is for the panel to cover the story, world, gameplay, and even some information about itemization.
"We're a long way from the campfire, from its comfort and hope. These are the fires of Diablo. Sanctuary has been destroyed, and Diablo has won," Shely said.

articles.title: WoW Forever Will Add All-New Content To Classic Azeroth This November
articles.summary: World of Warcraft Forever is Blizzard's next iteration on WoW Classic, one that will add new content in the form of zones, quests, dungeons, raids, and even a new playable race while keeping the old-school MMORPG's world and gameplay intact.
body: Revealed during BlizzCon 2026's opening ceremony, WoW Forever is Blizzard's attempt to give WoW Classic fans the "forever" game they've wanted for years. However, instead of the MMO progressing to the game's subsequent expansions and their new areas, as Classic has in the past, WoW Forever will instead keep the focus on WoW's original two continents, Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor.

Within that Classic backdrop will be up to 1,000 new quests, Blizzard said, as well as revamped zones, and three entirely new zones that fill out areas present on the map in vanilla WoW but were never accessible to players. There will be nine new dungeons to explore, two raids, and an additional PvP battleground. A new playable race is also part of the package: the Skyborne elves. One of the new playable zones will be their starting area, Blizzard said.

In addition to all-new content, Blizzard will be revamping classes with new talents and skills, as well as allowing for new class and race combinations. An option to toggle HD visuals and old-school graphics will also be included. Blizzard will continue to update WoW Forever with new content, but won't raise the level cap past 60.

articles.title: Warcraft Getting Its First New RTS Campaign In Two Decades–And It’s Playable Today
articles.summary: A new Warcraft 3 campaign exploring the origins of the Forsaken and the formation of the Undercity will be live later today, Blizzard announced as part of its BlizzCon 2026 opening ceremony announcements.
body: Titled Forsaken Kingdom, the DLC campaign will put a spotlight on the last days of Lordaeron after it fell to Arthas and how it became the home of the Forsaken many players are familiar with in World of Warcraft. The campaign will be available in Warcraft 3: Reforged, Blizzard's once-maligned remaster of 2003's RTS classic. While the new campaign costs money, the 3.0 update for Warcraft 3: Reforged is free and also releases today. The update adds new visual improvements and quality-of-life features.

This is just the latest update to Warcraft 3: Reforged that looks to salvage its poor reputation. In 2024, Blizzard released a 2.0 update as part of the franchise's 30th anniversary that sought to address many of the common complaints players have had with the remaster since its 2020 launch. Reports from the time indicated Warcraft 3: Reforged was the victim of budget cuts and rocky development, and even saw Blizzard expand its refund policy in the wake of its release.

articles.title: Why is Blizzard still announcing games years ahead of release? 'We want to convey confidence in some of our biggest bets coming forward'
articles.summary: Reactions to the StarCraft trailer shown at BlizzCon this year seem pretty universal. Initial excitement, immediately deflated when the words "STARCRAFT RETURNS 2030" appeared at the end.
body: Announcing videogames more than a couple of years ahead of release feels like a relic of the past. Everyone assumes games will get delayed anyway, and viewers are adding "at the earliest" as a footnote. Saying something is just around the corner earns goodwill, while saying it's three or four years away tells us to gear up for a hype cycle we'll be tired of before the actual game materializes—if it ever does.

Blizzard president Johanna Faries spoke to Bloomberg ahead of BlizzCon. "We want to convey confidence in some of our biggest bets coming forward," she said on this topic. "We're a Blizzard that's going to ship, and ship big, and ship on time, and all hands on deck to set those projects up for success."

Blizzard has so far managed to avoid being hit by Microsoft's recent layoffs, but more are coming next year. It's a good time to make sure everyone knows you've got loads of exciting projects in the works and you need as many staff as possible to make them a reality.

articles.title: WoW: The Last Titan Cinematic Ups The Stakes, But First, Xal’atath
articles.summary: As is BlizzCon tradition, a new World of Warcraft cinematic premiered during the BlizzCon 2026 opening ceremony, setting the stage for the MMORPG's next expansion, The Last Titan.
body: In a departure for BlizzCon, that glimpse was just about all fans learned about the new expansion, with Blizzard instead looking to put the focus more on the final content patch of the game's current Midnight expansion.

That update, titled Eclipse, will consist of a climactic showdown with the franchise's current main villain, Xal'atath. An in-game cinematic shown during the ceremony revealed Xal'atath's true objective, to merge with Azeroth's worldsoul and become unstoppable.
Blizzard additionally teased a new standalone game mode, and yet another expansion Remix experience, will also be coming to Midnight before the expansion's end.

As for The Last Titan's setting, it takes players back to Northrend, the continent previously seen in 2008's Wrath of the Lich King expansion. Much like how Blizzard revamped Silvermoon City and the Blood Elf lands of Quel'thalas in Midnight to great results, Northrend will be completely rebuilt from the ground up. Blizzard said more details about The Last Titan will be shared next year.

articles.title: Hearthstone’s First New Class In 4 Years And A More Story-Driven Journal Are On The Way
articles.summary: New class additions to Hearthstone don't come often, but the next one has been announced during BlizzCon 2026's Opening Ceremony: The Monk is coming to the card game, leaving just the Evoker as the lone class to be left out.
body: The Monk's upcoming addition was one of several major pieces of news for Hearthstone revealed. A new expansion called Reign of the Black Empire that is set 10,000 years in the past will focus on the Black Empire and a struggle between the Old Gods and the Titans.

If that excites the lore enjoyer in you, you'll also be happy to hear that the Journal is being transformed into The Journey. This is meant to give a more narrative-driven wrapper to the game, as it'll seek to tie the story together between expansions, modes, and limited-time events. The Journey will grow as you play through Reign of the Black Empire, tying together quests, achievements, and more elements of the game.

As far as the Monk goes, we don't know much in terms of how they'll play. We only got a short teaser for the new class, which marks the first such addition since the Death Knight arrived in 2022. The game originally launched with nine characters before later adding Demon Hunter and then Death Knight. The Monk will arrive in March 2027, with more details coming next year.

articles.title: Playing RTS with a controller? Total War: Warhammer 40,000 dev says it 'really does work' in their game: 'I think we've landed in a really solid spot'
articles.summary: The kids who grew up playing StarCraft on Nintendo 64 must have thumbs of steel. With the exception of a handful of games designed specifically for consoles like Herzog Zwei and Halo Wars, the RTS has not been a genre that's played well with controllers.
body: And yet, Total War developer Creative Assembly is committed to releasing Total War: Warhammer 40,000 on consoles. The studio's battle product owner Dave Petry told TechRadar at Gamescom he thinks it's a "myth" that controller support doesn't work for the RTS genre and that they've "landed something that really does work."

"Because yes, obviously, controllers are your primary method for using consoles, but it's just an input method. It's an accessibility tool, right? It's how you want to play or how you would like to play, and so we've always wanted to be able to bring that experience to people who want to use a gamepad."

Creative Assembly co-developed Halo Wars 2, which Petry cited as a specific example of a "really strong implementation of controller and RTS," though it benefits from its simplicity. When the more fiddly Age of Empires 2 came out on Xbox it had to have automated villagers who would gather resources and construct farms based on your preset preference, because that kind of micromanagement is a bit of a faff with twin sticks.

articles.title: Diablo 5 gameplay details from BlizzCon: More classes than ever before, procedurally-generated dungeons, and Diablo 2-style loot
articles.summary: Diablo 5 is shaping up to be very different from Diablo 4. The sequel is set a hundred years after Diablo 4 in the aftermath of Diablo (the demon)'s apocalyptic destruction of Sanctuary, and it's going to bring fundamental changes to combat, classes, and loot.
body: Several Diablo 5 developers took the stage today at BlizzCon 2026 to talk about their vision for the game, noting that everything is still a work-in-progress and subject to change between now and the spring 2029 release window.

A lot of Diablo 5's biggest changes feel like a response to both player reception of Diablo 4—specifically what it lacked compared to previous games and competitors, like Path of Exile—and the much darker setting, which Blizzard is "doubling down" on.

The campaign begins several years after a golden age for Sanctuary, right as it falls into the hands of the big bad Diablo. Like Mephisto in Diablo 4, Diablo will be a full character as opposed to just a boss you fight at the end. Much of the story will involve restoring the western continent and Westmarch, the most iconic location in the series, from its ravaged state.
Blizzard said we can expect to hear regular updates on the development of Diablo 5 starting next year, and emphasized that it will be changing things as it goes along based on player feedback.

videos.summary: Marvel's Wolverine's uneven story and sub-par combat are not enough to carry the game's 20-ish hour run-time, but it's the obnoxious, hand-holding game design that makes Marvel's Wolverine so objectionable; patronizing the player with constant guidance, pop up reminders, GPS pointers, audio pings…
